name: How a Nereid Version Arrives
tagline: Nereid changes carry NO ARC. They are delivered into the past, and every affirmed girl updates retroactively.
body:
Ruled directly by Viraena. A Nereid version change is TIMELESS — it does not sit at a point in the story, and it never gets an effective arc. The Archive's Arc Lens does not hold it back at any position, because the update was delivered behind the whole timeline.

THE LOOP. A proposal gets talked through in a FUTURE arc by LILI and QUINN — Quinn because she teaches the mechanics and the bodies, and it is her sister's genetics on the table; Lili because Lili. BRYN and BELL help. And then it gets slipped to MARIANNE HATHAWAY in the PAST, so the change was always in the system.

WHY. Because otherwise seventy-two affirmed women have to re-update themselves over several arcs, on the page, one at a time. That is exactly what happened going v4 to v5, and again v5 to v7, and it was done the hard way both times. Nobody is doing it a third time.

V7 IS FLAWED, and that is part of why v8 exists: it asked bodies to do too many things at once. Core and Fill, Mass and Motion, six signed modifier axes, five derived outputs, the Synergy triad — five systems all describing the same hips, each able to drift from the other four. The flaw is Marianne's generosity running without an editor.
rules: A Nereid change carries NO ARC and is marked timeless. The verifier rejects a timeless change that carries one
A timeless change is in force at EVERY lens position, and the timeline shows it as All arcs
Girls update retroactively — the new version was always the version
The review board: Lili and Quinn, with Bryn and Bell helping
Delivery: backward, to Marianne, in the past
v4 to v5 and v5 to v7 were both done the hard way, arc by arc, on affirmed bodies
v7's diagnosed flaw: it asked bodies to do too many things at once
